No edits were made in any candidate. All four candidates (base1, inv1, dom1, agg1) contain identical harness code, system prompts, and task prompts. The harness.diff files for inv1, dom1, and agg1 all state "(no change)", and all rollouts executed against harness hash 498c3a8834 without modification.

The variation in numerical outputs across rollouts (51, 41, 63, 42 for the digit sum) reflects model variance in Python computation, not harness differences. The decision documents explicitly attribute this: "the three different numerical answers (51, 41, 63) reflect model variance in the computation itself, not a harness failure or defect" (agg1.md). Each rollout called the identical LLM prompt and received different internal calculations, producing different answers—a reflection of stochastic model behavior, not harness edits.
</edits>
